trigger: Two jobs stopped by sustained system memory pressure; controller continued normally.
policy: Collect every RESOURCE_LIMIT and SKIPPED_RESOURCE_LIMIT record when reconciling the final study, not only the initially listed jobs.
Preserve original attempts and resource-limit counts in primary efficiency tables.
Register recovery separately using the same frozen inputs, model code, economic profile, seed and requested budget.
Do not exceed one simultaneous exact solve and one ALNS solve; resource recovery may run serially after the main queue when memory is available.
Restore the affected small exact case's long-budget coverage even when the frozen queue conditionally skips its 10800-second extension after a resource limit.
Include recovered results in explicitly labelled supplementary/reference tables and cumulative elapsed-cost accounting; do not replace failed primary observations.
Finish recovery or explicitly report an actual remaining resource blocker before declaring experiments and remote delivery complete.
